summary: Fortis Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an investor presentation dated November 3, 2026, covering third-quarter 2026 earnings and a new five-year capital outlook, discussed on a conference call. The materials are presented as image-encoded slides with no readable deal terms, and the filing carries no transactional event: no acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or capital return announcement is disclosed. This is a routine quarterly reporting and capital-plan communication by the utility registrant; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for capital-plan funding implications rather than any arbitrage angle.
